finding.headline: "The Grandmother's Bath Ritual"
finding.problem: "Back home, Mama or Grandma does the first bath with warm water and prayers. Here I'm alone with YouTube. I'm losing my culture and my confidence at once."
finding.person: Nigerian/African mum in diaspora whose own mother gave baby's first bath back home; she never learned the ritual and feels disconnected.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.
